title: Cosmic Ballet Dancers
description: Three blue-skinned ballerinas perform a dramatic lift and pose in a swirling cosmic setting. Their colorful tutus and bodies drip with bright paint as glowing stars and leaves float around them against a dark starry sky with lightning.
